integrity: The exact published facets and group generators are reconstructed directly. Exact binary linear algebra exhausts all 256 cocycles, while an independent graph reconstruction exhausts all 28 shortest dual cycles and verifies the published order-42 action and its two cycle orbits.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the fixed seven-vertex triangulation and mod-two cohomology. It does not assert triangulation-independence. The full text of Szilassi's 1986 regular-toroid paper was not retrievable during comparison, leaving a residual risk of an older equivalent formulation.
title: Seven facial and twenty-one essential hexagons in the Heawood dual of Möbius' torus
